issues.description: The test utility macro ALIGN_STACK introduces an extra 'sub esp, 4' offset. This causes the stack to be misaligned relative to the standard 16-byte alignment expected by the system and described in the macro comments, leading to potential crashes during C library calls like printf.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the 'sub esp, 4' instruction within the ALIGN_STACK macro to restore proper 16-byte alignment.
